lines.text: Moses tells the heads of the tribes that if a man makes a vow to the LORD, he must do everything he promised.
If a young woman's father prohibits her vow on the day he hears of it, the LORD will absolve her.
If a married woman's husband hears of her vow and says nothing that day, her vow stands.
Every vow a widow or divorced woman pledges to fulfill is binding on her, and a priest must confirm it.
If a husband nullifies his wife's vows after he hears of them, he must bring a sin offering.
